blocks.prompt: 2. An investor invests Rs. 150000 at an annual compound interest rate of 6% for 8 years. Find the total amount will he get after 8 years.
blocks.explanation:
Compound interest (sood dar sood) ka matlab hai ke har saal ka munafa asal raqam mein jud jata hai, aur agle saal 6% is barhi hui raqam par milta hai.
Is liye har saal raqam ek hi number 1.06 se multiply hoti hai. Jab har qadam par ek hi number se zarb ho to list G.P. banti hai.
Plan: pehle multiplier (common ratio) nikalenge, phir 8 saal baad ki raqam G.P. ke term ke tor par likhenge, aur \((1.06)^8\) ko qadam ba qadam nikalenge.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(P = 150000\), 6% saalana compound interest, 8 saal.
Humein find karna hai: 8 saal baad kul raqam \(A\).
Tareeqa: Shuru ki raqam aur har saal ke baad ki raqam G.P. banati hain jis ka \(r = 1.06\). 8 saal baad raqam \(P r^8\) hogi, kyunke 8 dafa 1.06 se multiply hui.

Saalana multiplier nikalein
\[r = 1 + \dfrac{6}{100} = 1.06\]
Kyun: Rs. 100 par ek saal mein Rs. 6 munafa milta hai to raqam 106 ho jati hai, yani 100 ka 1.06 guna. Is liye "6% barhna" ka matlab hai "1.06 se multiply karna". Yahi G.P. ka common ratio hai.

Raqamon ko G.P. ki tarah likhein
\[150000,\ 150000(1.06),\ 150000(1.06)^2,\ \ldots\]
\[A = 150000(1.06)^8\]
Kyun: Pehla term shuru ki raqam hai (abhi saal 0). Har saal ek aur 1.06 ka factor lagta hai, is liye 8 saal baad 8 factors: \(150000(1.06)^8\). G.P. ki zubaan mein yeh 9th term hai, \(a_9 = a_1 r^{8}\).
Dhyan dein: 8 saal ka matlab power 8 hai, 9 nahi; pehla term khud saal 0 ki raqam hai.

\((1.06)^8\) squaring se nikalein
\[(1.06)^2 = 1.1236\]
\[(1.06)^4 = (1.1236)^2 = 1.26247696\]
\[(1.06)^8 = (1.26247696)^2\]
\[\approx 1.59384807\]
Kyun: 1.06 ko aath dafa multiply karne ke bajaye teen dafa square kiya: pehle power 2, phir 4, phir 8. Is ki wajah exponents ka qanoon \((x^m)^2 = x^{2m}\) hai. Is tarah ghalti ka imkaan bhi kam hota hai aur waqt bhi bachta hai.

Raqam nikalein
\[A = 150000 \times 1.59384807\]
\[\approx 239077.21\]
Kyun: Shuru ki raqam ko 8 saal ke factor se multiply kiya. Investor ko taqreeban Rs. 239077.21 milenge.
Tasdeeq: agar simple interest hota to har saal Rs. 9000, yani 8 saal mein Rs. 72000 munafa, kul 222000. Compound mein munafa par bhi munafa milta hai, is liye jawab is se zyada (taqreeban 89077 munafa) hona chahiye, aur hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Answer key mein Rs. 239077.50 likha hai. \(150000(1.06)^8\) ki sahi qeemat Rs. 239077.21 hai. Key ka farq is liye hai ke \((1.06)^8\) ko pehle hi 1.59385 tak round kar diya gaya. Exam mein rounding aakhri qadam par karein.
